description: Implementation class for data access object (DAO) for Group entities, including methods for retrieving groups based on permissions, IDs, and group type. Implements database queries using JPA and Querydsl.

classes.name: GroupDaoImpl
classes.description: DAO implementation for handling Group entities, providing methods to query groups by permissions, IDs, and group type.

methods.name: getGroupsListBypermissions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of Group objects that have permissions matching the provided set of permission IDs.

methods.name: listGroupByIds
methods.description: Returns a list of Group objects based on a set of group IDs.

methods.name: listGroup
methods.description: Fetches a list of Group objects filtered by a specific GroupType.
